item.title: Embedded Machine Learning Engineer
item.description:
As a deep-tech startup, we are looking for talented and passionate people with an appetite for problem solving. Besides the minimal requirements for this job position, your profile is a good fit to our company if you have the following values:

  1. High flexibility and adaptability.
  2. Tranquility to work under pressure.
  3. Appetite for learning and problem solving.
  4. Critical thinking.
  5. Ability to communicate effectively.
  6. Keen to collaboration.
  7. Proper time management.
  8. Highly autodidact, independent and proactive.

Responsibilities:

  • Actively participate in the planning and execution of the development of the Embedded Software in the 10 Million cores SpiNNcloud Machine.
  • Explore energy and performance driven optimizations to machine learning algorithms.
  • Develop hardware-aware optimizations for cutting edge ML algorithms.
  • Build a robust and consistent compiler infrastructure for SpiNNcloud hardware.
  • Design and implementation of benchmarks involving different metrics (e.g., Latency, Energy Efficiency, Energy-delay product, etc.).
  • Contribute to the development and documentation of cool demonstrators.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Experience with Tiny Machine Learning.
  • Strong programming skills and substantial development experience in Python, and C, involving data structures, graphs, and object-oriented programming.
  • Solid understanding of Machine Learning algorithms.
  • Experience with embedded systems involving multicore environments and sensors.
  • Required expertise in development tools (e.g., git or svn) for revision control.
  • BSc, MSc or Dipl.-Ing. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or any other related computationally intensive field.

Added value:

  • Active contributor in Github or any other hosting for software development with version control.
  • Experience with DevOps and continuous integration & delivery tools (e.g., Gitlab).
  • Understanding of Event-based Machine Learning or Neuromorphic algorithms.
  • Experience working with Neuromorphic hardware (e.g., Loihi or SpiNNaker).
  • Dr.-Ing., or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematical sciences, or any other related computationally intensive field.
  • Experience developing Computer vision applications with real-time sensor streams.

We offer a highly competitive salary with reallocation benefits in a flexible and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer, and hence we welcome people of different backgrounds, nationalities, and experiences.

Your contact: Hector Andres Gonzalez Diaz

Location: SpiNNcloud Systems GmbH, Freiberger Straße 37, 01067 Dresden

item.title: (Senior)Technical Program Manager
item.description:
(Senior)Technical Program Manager

As (Senior) Technical Program Manager, you’ll own project management across a diverse set of programs from customer-facing commitments and requirements to grant-funded projects and internal cross-functional initiatives. You’ll build and run the project management system: processes, planning, reporting, risk management, and delivery rhythm. 

You will partner closely with Engineering Leads and engineers, Product, Operations, and leadership to ensure we hit milestones, communicate clearly, and deliver reliably. 

 

What You’ll Do 

  • Own delivery across multiple project types, including: 

    • customer requirements, delivery timelines, and deployment commitments 

    • internal cross-functional programs  

    • grant-funded projects (milestones, reporting, compliance coordination) 

  • Highly comfortable operating in an Agile environment and navigating ambiguity:
    • thrive in fast-moving, iterative teams, proactively create clarity from incomplete information, and bring structure and accountability without unnecessary bureaucracy.

 

  • Define and implement SpiNNcloud’s project management processes 

    • project intake and prioritization 

    • stage gates / milestone planning 

    • dependency management across teams 

    • change control and scope management (especially for customer commitments) 

 

  • Drive execution rigor 

    • run project kick-offs, weekly cadences, milestone reviews, and retros 

    • follow up with teams on deliverables, timelines, and accountability 

    • proactively surface risks, blockers, and trade-offs with mitigation plans 

 

  • Create clean reporting 

    • build lightweight dashboards and executive summaries (status, risks, ETA confidence) 

    • maintain a single source of truth for program status across the company 

 

  • Improve cross-functional communication 

    • translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders 

    • ensure customer-facing teams have clear delivery narratives and timelines 

 

 

What We’re Looking For 

  • 4+ years in technical project/program management, owning delivery across cross-functional engineering teams (hardware, software, systems, or platform environments). 

  • Customer-facing delivery experience: proven ability to manage external commitments (requirements, timelines, scope changes), align stakeholders, and communicate clearly with customers/partners. 

  • Demonstrated ability to design and operationalize project management processes in a scaling organization (intake, prioritization, governance, cadence, reporting). 

  • Strong track record of driving complex, dependency-heavy programs to completion balancing speed, quality, and stakeholder alignment. 

  • Strong execution mindset with comfort in ambiguity: you bring structure, clarity, and accountability without unnecessary bureaucracy. 

  • Excellent stakeholder management: able to push for decisions, surface trade-offs, manage expectations, and negotiate scope and resources. 

  • Familiarity with Jira, Agile and Scrum. 

 

 

Preferred Experience 

  • Exposure to HPC, AI infrastructure, or deep-tech products. 

  • Experience with EU-funded or other public funded programs.

item.title: (Senior)Product Manager - AI Infrastructure
item.description:
The Role 

We are hiring a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end lifecycle of our AI inference product direction. This includes market discovery and competitive intelligence, requirements definition, roadmap execution, and go-to-market readiness. You will partner closely with Engineering and Research and collaborate with Marketing and Sales to translate technical differentiation into clear product narratives and measurable customer value. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Market research & strategy 

  • build a sharp understanding of the AI inference and LLM market (buyer needs, adoption patterns, evaluation criteria, and emerging trends) 

  • identify high-value segments and use cases where we can win (cost, performance, latency, throughput, energy, deployment model, etc.) 

  • Competitive & ecosystem analysis 

  • maintain an up-to-date view of competitors and alternatives (chips, systems, cloud offerings, and inference stacks) 

  • translate competitive insights into positioning, requirements, and roadmap priorities 

  • Requirements & roadmap ownership 

  • work with Engineering and Research to define product requirements, milestones, and success metrics 

  • drive roadmap prioritization with clear tradeoffs and rationale 

  • ensure execution stays connected to customer needs and measurable outcomes 

  • GTM + sales enablement 

  • partner with Marketing on messaging, launches, and content strategy 

  • support Sales with enablement assets: pitch narratives, competitive battlecards, FAQs, case studies, and evaluation guidance 

  • Technical storytelling & content 

  • create crisp, credible technical content (blogs, whitepapers, solution briefs, product docs, and presentations) 

  • articulate “why we win” clearly to technical and business stakeholders 

  • Hands-on analysis 

  • use data to drive decisions: analyze benchmarks, workload characteristics, and performance/efficiency tradeoffs 

  • build lightweight Python tools/scripts to validate assumptions and support product decisions 

 

Qualifications 

The more of the following qualifications you bring, the stronger the fit for this role: 

  1. Strong semiconductor and accelerator expertise, including familiarity with GPUs and TPUs, and an understanding of how customers evaluate hardware and system trade-offs such as performance, throughput, latency, deployability, and operational efficiency. 

  1. Strong machine learning depth, ideally supported by a university degree/PhD or significant experience in ML, AI systems, or a related area, with a solid understanding of ML concepts and inferencing. 

  1. Demonstrated ability to translate technical insight into product strategy, including segmentation, positioning, differentiated requirements, and roadmap prioritization. 

  1. Proven effectiveness working with Engineering and Research teams in technically complex environments, driving alignment, trade-offs, and execution. 

  1. Basic programming proficiency and comfort working with technical artifacts. 

  1. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical narratives and enablement content for internal and external audiences. 

  1. High ownership and strong stakeholder management, with the ability to drive decisions, align cross-functional teams, and deliver outcomes.

item.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO & Office Manager (m/f/d)
item.description:

  • Prepare briefings, agendas, and follow-up materials for meetings
  • Act as a gatekeeper, prioritizing incoming requests and communications

Operational Efficiency

  • Proactively identify ways to optimize the CEO’s time and workflows
  • Anticipate needs and address issues before they arise
  • Track key action items and ensure timely execution
  • Support decision-making through preparation of relevant information

Communication & Coordination

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities

  • Ability to prioritize effectively across executive and operational tasks
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • High level of discretion and professionalism
  • Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail

Languages

  • Spanish and German: Nice to have

Mindset

  • Service-oriented with a focus on maximizing executive productivity
  • Hands-on and willing to take ownership of office operations

What Success Looks Like

What We Offer

We offer a highly competitive salary with reallocation benefits in a flexible and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer, and hence we welcome people of different backgrounds, nationalities, and experiences.

item.title: Senior NoC Research Engineer (Network-on-Chip)
item.description:
Senior NoC Research Engineer (Network-on-Chip) About SpiNNcloud

SpiNNcloud Systems is a pioneering deep-tech company developing brain inspired computing hardware and software based on the SpiNNaker2 technology. Our platform provides remote access to cutting-edge sparse computing resources, enabling breakthroughs in AI, HPC, and energy-efficient computing.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Network-on-Chip (NoC) Research Engineer to shape the on-chip and chip-to-chip interconnect of SpiNNext, our next-generation chip. In systems built from very large numbers of cores, moving data efficiently determines both performance and energy efficiency. You will model, simulate and evaluate interconnect architectures under real ML workloads, and turn your findings into quantitative design decisions. You will report to our CTO and work closely with our chip architecture, hardware and software teams.

Key Responsibilities

Interconnect Architecture & Modelling

  • Explore and evaluate NoC topologies, router and switch designs, arbitration, flow control, QoS and congestion control
  • Build and maintain architectural models and simulations, using SST, gem5 or custom cycle-level and analytical models
  • Develop traffic generators that reflect real ML workloads: collective communication, tensor parallelism and memory traffic

Performance Analysis & Design Trade-offs

  • Analyse power, performance and area (PPA) trade-offs and back recommendations with quantitative evidence
  • Ensure deadlock- and livelock-free designs through analysis, formal methods or simulation
  • Investigate adaptive routing strategies and topology options

Protocols, IP & Scale-out

  • Translate complex protocol and IP specifications (AXI, CHI, APB) into clear design requirements
  • Evaluate third-party interconnect IP and support build-versus-buy decisions
  • Assess how RDMA concepts and chip-to-chip interfaces shape data movement between accelerators at system scale

Research & Collaboration

  • Present findings and recommendations to architecture and leadership teams
  • Contribute to publications and patents in on-chip networks and data movement for ML
Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • PhD, or Master's with equivalent research experience, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field
  • Senior-level track record in NoC or interconnect architecture, in industry or applied research

Technical Skills

  • Strong background in on-chip interconnect and traffic management: NoC topologies, routers and switches, arbitration, flow control, QoS and congestion control
  • Good understanding of ML workloads and accelerator architectures, including how collective communication, tensor parallelism and memory traffic stress the interconnect
  • Working knowledge of on-chip protocols such as AXI, CHI or AHB
  • Understanding of RDMA concepts and transports (InfiniBand, RoCE), including queue pairs, memory registration and zero-copy transfers
  • Experience reasoning about PPA trade-offs with quantitative evidence
  • Hands-on architectural modelling and simulation (SST, gem5 or own models), with strong Python and C++
  • Ability to read complex protocol and IP specifications and turn them into clear design requirements
  • Experience with deadlock and livelock avoidance, adaptive routing or topology exploration
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, and a proactive, collaborative approach to open-ended problems
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with chip-to-chip and die-to-die interfaces such as PCIe, Ethernet or UCIe
  • Experience with memory subsystems such as HBM and CXL
  • Publications or patents in on-chip networks, interconnect architecture, or data movement for ML or HPC
  • Familiarity with massively parallel architectures
What We Offer
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • 30 days annual vacation, up to 2 weeks of work abroad
  • Work on cutting-edge sparse computing technology
  • High-impact role with direct influence on the architecture of SpiNNext
  • Collaborative team culture with experienced engineers from academia and industry
  • Equity participation in a growing deep-tech company
How to Apply

Please include:

  • CV highlighting relevant interconnect, NoC or architecture research experience
  • Brief cover letter describing an interconnect or data-movement problem you analysed and what you recommended
  • Links to publications, patents or public code (optional)
  • Salary expectations and earliest start date
  • Your current location, and whether you would need visa sponsorship and/or relocation support to work in Germany.

SpiNNcloud Systems is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or national origin.
